sample_unit: questions and case scenarios (34 guideline questions, 4 cases)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of LLM responses on adrenal incidentaloma queries
links.effect: High text complexity across models, with Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 10.6-17.4.
links.quote: Readability analysis revealed high text complexity (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level: 10.6-17.4), and inter-rater reliability was excellent (intraclass correlation coefficient: 0.876-0.961, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the performance, hallucination rates, quality, and readability of four commercial LLMs on guideline queries and clinical case scenarios assessed by endocrinologists, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
